events.summary: Hey Shopkeepers,Another update just released, where we have unhidden the Rat Wrangler starting scenario!ChangesThe Rat Wrangler starting scenario (previously secret) is now visible alongside the other starting scenariosA cleared inspection that resulted from showing contraband in the display case will no longer grant Security reputation. events.title: Probably Stolen: Cyberpunk Pawnshop Simulator
events.summary: Welcome shopkeepers,We’re thrilled to announce our new game called Probably Stolen, with a playtest available right now! What is the game?Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk pawnshop simulator set in a dystopian space station where you gotta trade, craft, flip goods, maybe smuggle a little on the side, and try not to piss off the wrong people. It’s up to you to decide how far you’re willing to go to stay afloat and earn enough cash to own the shop before rent gets out of hand. About the developer:Dev
